label: F-03
title: Spec deviation: the script grants phUSD mint authority to the new Antimatter contract (a third mint grant not in story 082's Phase 5 list) under machine-only approval
fingerprintProvenance: Copied verbatim from reports/31/script-audits/stable-staker-v2-cutover/classified-findings.json (not recomputed). finding-manager cross-check: sha256(fingerprintBasis) reproduces it byte-for-byte.
description: Story AC4 and Phase 5 list exactly two grants: V2 → Antimatter and V2 → phUSD. The script adds `phUSD.setMinter(Antimatter, true)`, gated by `GRANT_ANTIMATTER_PHUSD_MINT = true`. The Law-1 check passes. `Antimatter` mints phUSD only inside `annihilate`, at exactly the antimatter amount the caller burns. The approved Antimatter minter set is asserted to be exactly {V2} (`approvedMinterCount() == 1`), and the phUSD candidate mask moves only by the V1 bit (511→510), with mintVersion unchanged. The new unbacked-issuance channel is therefore bounded by V2 emissions (2.1 × V1's phUSD rate, per story AC3) plus OWNER mints. That is Antimatter's accepted design (1 AM = 1 unbacked phUSD), and memory ss18l1's wont-fix covers the top-up. The story sits in `auto-complete/` with 'machine approval — not human-reviewed', and its review carried this forward as '[medium] ... the human should be aware before broadcast'. It is filed here so the human sees it in the audit channel.
impact: A new mainnet contract gains phUSD mint authority without an explicit human sign-off in the story. No exploit path was found: annihilate burns the caller's own AM one-for-one, and AM minting is restricted to V2 and the owner.
attackPath: N/A - no exploit path: annihilate burns the caller's own Antimatter 1:1; Antimatter minting is restricted to V2 and the owner.

severityRationale: A pure Law-2 deviation: a third mint grant not in story-082's Phase 5 list, under machine-only story approval. It is necessary (Decision 3's negative control) and bounded, so there is no security severity; reported as F-type so the human signs off before broadcast. KI#11 is a partial match only and does not suppress it.
recommendation: Record a human sign-off for the Antimatter phUSD grant in story 082 (or a follow-up story) before broadcast, and note in the Phase 8 NatSpec that the grant's issuance is bounded by `approvedMinterCount()==1` plus the V2 rate.

Fork preview: `phUSD.setMinter(Antimatter) - VERIFIED at current mintVersion`, `phUSD minter delta OK (live mask / V1 revoked): 510 true`, Phase 8 `approvedMinterCount() == 1` passed; phUSD supply delta during cutover = +85.471458401387198196 = exactly the sum of V1 pending rewards (no other mint).
